blocks.text: Backtracking (wapas palatna) masle hal karne ka aisa tareeqa hai jis mein hal qadam ba qadam banaya jata hai. Agar pata chale ke koi khaas raasta hal tak nahi le ja raha, to aap bas wapas jate hain aur doosra raasta aazmate hain. Yeh aisa hi hai jaise naqshe (map) par alag alag raaste aazmana aur ghalat raste ka pata chalte hi wapas mur jana. Yeh tareeqa aksar un maslon mein istemal hota hai jin mein tamam mumkin options dekhne hon, jaise puzzles ya alag alag combinations (mel) wale masle.

blocks.prompt: N-Queens masle ke hawale se Backtracking samjhaiye (long question 5).
blocks.explanation: N x N board par N queens aise rakhni hain ke koi do queens ek row, column ya tirchi line (diagonal) mein na hon. Har row mein ek queen, pehli row se shuru: har row mein baen se daen columns aazmayein aur pehle mehfooz (safe) column par queen rakh kar agli row par jayein. Agar kisi row mein koi safe column na mile to pichhli row par wapas ja kar (backtrack) us ki queen ko agle safe column par le jayein aur aage barhein. Tamam N rows bhar jayein to hal mil gaya; aise har option aazma kar tamam hal milte hain. N = 4 ke 2 hal hain, maslan rows 1 se 4 mein columns 2, 4, 1, 3. Backtracking nakam raste (branch) ko foran chhor deta hai, is liye har tarteeb aazmane se kahin kam configurations dekhta hai.

blocks.text: Yeh program N-Queens backtracking se hal karta hai: har row mein queen rakhta hai, band gali (dead end) par wapas ja kar agla column aazmata hai, aur wapsi (backtracks) ginta hai. n ki value 4 se 6 ya 8 kar ke Run karein.

items: Backtracking: qadam ba qadam hal banao, band gali par wapas jao aur doosra raasta aazmao; N-Queens mashhoor misal hai.
